blocks.content: After auto-apply is on, you still own exemptions, whether the segment is ready, and the mode. A rule is the configuration that aggregates or drops a metric.

| What | What stays in your control |
| --- | --- |
| **Custom rules** | A rule you created yourself. You can still add and edit custom rules. |
| **Affix or drop rules** | An affix rule matches a prefix or suffix in the metric name. A drop rule discards the metric. Auto-apply does not modify these rules. |
| **Exact-match rules** | A rule for one metric name. Auto-apply can remove or replace it unless you exempt that metric. |
| **Cost-first leftovers** | A leftover that exceeds the budget stays unapplied in the UI while auto-apply is on. Turn auto-apply off to apply it from the UI, or use the API. |
